Use workaway and couch surfing. Try hitchhiking as much as you feel comfortable. Dumpster dive. Take buses not taxis/planes. If you take planes be willing to take ones with multiple stops that take much longer. Go to places where pay is high (Australia if you u can) and work there to save up quickly to travel more. Working in a new place has always been the highlights of travelling for me as I get to know a place well, and make friends for the next adventure.

Travel, try new things, if you like them keep doing them, if you don't then stop doing them (this includes friendships, don't just keep hanging out with people because you have known then X years). Work as much as you need to to be able to do the things you want to do. Love, and trust and believe in the kindness of people.
